outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster image, not a statistical plot; no significance symbols are present.
Panel B is a histology (H&E) image with manual annotations, not a statistical plot; no significance symbols are present.
Panel C shows H&E and spatial gene expression heatmap images, not a statistical plot with significance symbols.

Panel D (GSEA enrichment plots) reports exact NES, FDR, and p-values directly on the plots rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so there are no symbols requiring a defined threshold mapping.
Panel E reports exact p-values above each bar rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so there are no symbols requiring a defined threshold mapping.
